=INSERT INTO opportunities (title, target_audience, target_industry, core_problem, trend_score, commercial_score, competition_gap_score, opportunity_score, recommended_offer, recommended_channel, estimated_deal_value_vnd)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.target_audience || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.target_industry || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.core_problem || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.trend_score_val || 80 }},
  {{ $json.commercial_score || 80 }},
  {{ $json.competition_gap_score || 75 }},
  {{ $json.opportunity_score || 80 }},
  '{{ ($json.recommended_offer || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ ($json.recommended_channel || '').replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  {{ $json.estimated_deal_value_vnd || 50000000 }}
)
RETURNING id, title, opportunity_score, target_industry, recommended_offer, estimated_deal_value_vnd;
